title: Urgent shop goal is overwritten or paired with stale ware

impact.description: A poisoned, bleeding or hungry character can select another shop or a ware from an earlier goal; actual game transaction outcome pending.

notes: Forced shop assignment is followed by helpers that ignore that forced shop and by unconditional goal reset. A stale ware can instead make the second already-flowing test accept the forced shop.

references.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reference.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reported_sources.text:
`borg_choose_shop()`: "If poisoned or bleeding -- flow to temple"
  (`goal.shop = 3`) and "flow to general store" (`goal.shop = 0`) have no
  effect on the choice: none of the buy/sell helpers reads `goal.shop`, and
  unless one of them sets a ware the next step resets
  `goal.shop = goal.ware = goal.item = -1`. They matter only if
  `goal.ware != -1` came in with `goal.shop == -1`: then
  `borg_think_shop_buy_useful()` returns false at once ("already have a
  target") and the second "already flowing" test returns true with the
  forced shop and the stale ware.

next_at_import: Validate a legal normal-rule scene and negative controls before calling a gameplay correction carried.
